key: Yowza, can a guy get some Great Balls up here? Please?
en: Yowza, can a guy get some Great Balls up here?  Please?
ja: うわっ、ここでスーパーボールって手に入らないもんかね? 頼むよ?

key: I guess I'll just have to make do with the specialty balls from Critical Capture for now.
en: I guess I'll just have to make do with the specialty balls from Critical Capture for now.
ja: とりあえず、クリティカルキャプチャーの特製ボールで間に合わせるしかないか。

key: I hear there's a Gym Leader who made her Gym out in the desert.
en: I hear there's a Gym Leader who made her Gym out in the desert.
ja: 砂漠にジムを構えたジムリーダーがいるらしいぜ。

key: If you ever head out that way, make sure you've got plenty of supplies.
en: If you ever head out that way, make sure you've got plenty of supplies.
ja: もしあっちに向かうなら、物資はたっぷり持っていくんだぞ。

key: Hum! Time for a new challenge!
en: Hum! Time for a new challenge!
ja: ふん! 新たな挑戦の時だ!

key: Mountains are great, but they're very different from a desert hike.
en: Mountains are great, but they're very different from a desert hike.
ja: 山もいいが、砂漠のハイキングとはまるで勝手が違うな。

key: Mountains, it's just a matter of finding a way up.
en: Mountains, it's just a matter of finding a way up.
ja: 山なら、登る道を見つけるだけの話だ。

key: In the desert, you'll have to learn to navigate a large area based on just a few landmarks between the sands.
en: In the desert, you'll have to learn to navigate a large area based on just a few landmarks between the sands.
ja: 砂漠じゃ、砂の合間にある数少ない目印を頼りに、広大なエリアを進む術を身につけなきゃならん。
その覚悟はできてるぞ!

key: I hear the Eviolite from this region has a special property.
en: I hear the Eviolite from this region has a special property.
ja: この地方のしんかのきせきには、特別な性質があるらしいな。

key: Apparently it also works like an Everstone-- your Pokémon won't evolve by level if it's holding one.
en: Apparently it also works like an Everstone-- your Pokémon won't evolve by level if it's holding one.
ja: どうやら、かわらずのいしのようにも働くらしくてな――持たせておけば、レベルアップでは進化しなくなるんだと。
